snapshot: WHO Region of the Americas. Provinces and territories deliver health care; Ottawa's levers are transfers, regulation through Health Canada and public health through the Public Health Agency of Canada.

agenda.title: Health transfers after Budget 2026
agenda.text: The November 2026 federal budget gave provinces no increase in health-care funding. Ottawa had extended home care and mental health funding by one year in October; provinces say that is not enough and are asking for long-term commitments.

agenda.title: Pharmacare
agenda.text: National pharmacare is unfinished. Analysts say the budget falls short of what a full programme would need.

agenda.title: Vaccines and measles
agenda.text: Canada's large measles outbreak was declared over at the end of October 2026 after more than 6,400 cases. Health Canada approved new mRNA influenza and combined influenza-COVID vaccines in November, and the national advisory committee now recommends hepatitis B vaccination for all infants.
